body: Do you plan to release the german translation in csv-format as well?

comments.body:
Unfortunately we can only produce the other formats for translations where we have the original markup source which I do not think we have for the German translation. 

Can you try getting in touch with the translator or alternatively create the markdown files yourself using the version which we do have?
